scenario.note: At most one of the years (1, 2, 3) has short-time workers above zero; this is enforced via a logical rule that at least one of the conditions must hold, with the constraint that only one can be non-zero.
A logical rule is applied to the overmanned workers at unskilled level in year 1, requiring at least 860 overmanned workers if any retraining to a higher skill level occurs in year 1.
Retraining from unskilled to semi-skilled in year 1 is only allowed if the total overmanned unskilled workers exceed 860.
